audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read "Fizz" while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei, with Hwei-favoured whys printed underneath the Fizz rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[] exactly, and 49.17% over 2888 games is an even lane. Kit basis: Urchin Strike reaches 550 units and Playful / Trickster 400, so before he has cooldown uptime Fizz cannot get onto a champion who paints from range.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Hwei, phases[3..4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Hwei, with the four affected whys rewritten to match the verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] said both champions scale similarly off the first item on a row the chart gives to Hwei. spikes[2] used the placeholder phrase "(Riftmaker/Nashor's-style ramp)" instead of naming what actually spikes.
audit.why: Playful / Trickster's cooldown curve is the real spike story: 16s at rank 1 down to 8s at rank 5. That halving is what turns a punishable dive into a repeatable one, and it appeared nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: whys[5] states the range reason for the row; the 16s-to-8s curve now appears in cooldowns, phases[3..5].why, dosFull[0].d and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: The untargetability was mentioned but never given a consequence or a number, and the page told the reader elsewhere to "commit" without saying what happens to a combo spent into the hop. Hwei's own tools were called "EE fear", "EQ root" and "W root/charm". wants.you[3] claimed his E gets "extra reach" near walls and terrain, which is not in the kit.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable." Anything you spend into that window hits nothing. Chum the Waters travels 1300 units — the same as Hwei's own R — and attaches to a champion that touches it, so it is a visible line, not a point-blank cast. Hwei's E sub-abilities are Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE); his W paints are Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights.
audit.corrected: Bait the hop and commit after it, not into it; Grim Visage (EQ) is reserved for the frame he lands. The terrain claim was removed rather than restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The auto-attack reset was absent, so the page gave the reader no tell for when the all-in actually starts.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell: "Fizz's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Seastone Trident (W)) — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the ability cast." Seastone Trident empowers his next attack and is a 7s cooldown at rank 1, 3s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[2].d, loading, early and wants.you[3]: step back on the wind-up, not on the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles; cooldowns now carries Playful / Trickster 16s-8s, Urchin Strike 550 units on 8s, and Chum the Waters 1300 units on 120s.

notes: Chart: all seven full-layer sides read "Fizz" against content win[] of Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Sides now match content and packet.levelChart; win[] needed no edit. Ratings left at 7/7/7/7/8/7/7. Worth flagging to the user: Chum the Waters is 1300 range — identical to Hwei's own R — so the old advice to "not stand still near his ult range" covered most of the lane and taught nothing. The actionable version is that the fish has to attach to a champion, so breaking the line and standing behind minions is the counterplay. I removed rather than restated wants.you[3]'s claim that Playful / Trickster gets "extra reach" near walls and terrain: nothing in the kit supports it, and it read like invented mechanics. Did NOT assert whether minions block Chum the Waters, whether Playful / Trickster's grounding affects anything in Hwei's kit (he has no dash), or whether Grim Visage can be buffered through the untargetable window — none of that is in the kit text. No report entries touched: no lint hits there, and the sweep excludes them.
